about_the_game:
Get ready for an adrenaline-pumping 3D bike racing adventure! Zoom through stunning environments with ultra-realistic graphics and smooth controls. Whether you're weaving through traffic or flying off ramps, every race feels real.

Features:

  • Realistic 3D graphics and dynamic environments

  • Multiple bikes to for the player to choose from. (1 bike available in Demo)

  • Smart AI opponents with increasing difficulty

  • Varied tracks: city, desert, forest and many more. (2 tracks available in Demo)

    Race hard, ride free — the road is yours!
